working_definition: Olfactory projection neuron type vPN_DA1 (Xie et al. 2021) at 0 h or 24 h APF.
searches_performed: immature antennal lobe projection neuron vPN_DA1

best_match.fbbt_definition: Antennal lobe projection neuron that derives from the ventral antennal lobe neuroblast.

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (vPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067351 antennal lobe projection neuron vPN (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for vPN_DA1.
